Deviload 2.7.0 makes Devil Music faster to use, easier to organize, and more personal.

- Faster playback with a persistent music engine, preparation of the next song, and a bounded disk cache. Reuse cached audio across restarts and choose the cache size in Music settings.
- A wider music workspace with a library sidebar, pinned liked songs, Back and Home navigation, shelf arrows, clearer track menus, and an always-visible volume slider.
- Bring public Spotify and YouTube Music playlists into Devil Music. Matching shows progress and can be stopped or canceled. Spotify public previews can omit tracks; file exports remain available for a more complete transfer. Review uncertain matches before adding them.
- Create and organize playlists, change covers, search and sort tracks, use smart collections, and download MP3s from the player.
- Recommendations learn locally from listening and feedback. Choose favorite artists, hide unwanted recommendations, or use a private session. Export your music profile to move it to another computer.
- Optional Discord Rich Presence shows the current song, artist, cover, and progress through Discord Desktop. Pause, private listening, or switching it off clears the music activity. No Discord token or separate account connection is required.
- Fire-colored playback indicators, sound presets, prepared-track transitions, lyrics when available, and concise dismissible What's new notes.
- Updated Russian and Spanish translations and smaller, clearer music settings.
- Devil Convert joins the named tool family. Sound settings can be reset in one click; Continue listening resumes the displayed song, and shelf arrows stay centered when pressed.

Listening without an account still depends on the upstream service and network. Availability and first-play speed can vary; this update does not guarantee access to restricted tracks. The macOS build remains unsigned by Apple.

Your existing downloads, settings, and music profile remain on this computer. The music cache contains audio; profile backups do not.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.7...v2.7.0
